description: TTS cue ID to subtitle/caption text map. Used for typewriter display when audio plays.

cues.run1_start_1: The maze breathes on a schedule. Every twenty seconds, it shifts. Learn the rhythm.
cues.run1_start_2: You have two minutes before the first gate moves. Count.
cues.run1_start_3: Trust what you hear. For now.
cues.run2_start_1: The Architect speaks. But the signal is compromised.
cues.run2_start_2: Some of what you hear is true. Some is not. You will learn to tell the difference.
cues.run2_start_3: The hum leads somewhere. Whether it leads to the exit — that is the question.
cues.run3_start_1: Two clocks now. Major shift every thirty seconds. Minor shift every ten.
cues.run3_start_2: There are exits that are not exits. The real one plays a different tone.
cues.run3_start_3: Both clocks lie if you let them. Move before they sync.
cues.wrong_turn_3: The grid does not bend for you here.
cues.wrong_turn_6: The path ends. The clock does not.
cues.shift_warning_2: The grid is about to breathe. Move.
cues.shift_warning_3: Five seconds to configuration change. Find open space.
cues.exit_found: Exit confirmed. You remembered the rhythm.
cues.decoy_exit_2: This is a test. The real exit sounds different.
cues.lie_3: I see the gate. Go west.
cues.lie_5: The signal is strongest to your right.
cues.lie_6: Turn back. The exit is behind you.
cues.truth_3: I see the gate. Go west.
cues.truth_5: The signal is strongest to your right.
cues.truth_6: Turn back. The exit is behind you.
